# About this Book {#about-the-book}

*Robust Portfolio Construction and Risk Analysis* (RPCRA) is a graduate level textbook that provides a comprehensive and rigorous account of the mathematical foundations of modern portfolio theory viewed through the immensely practical lens of Robust Statistical Methods. The book develops the mathematical, statistical, and computational tools and techniques needed to construct, evaluate, and manage investment portfolios in the presence of noise.

The text integrates classical mean-variance portfolio theory — the estimation of expected returns and modeling risk, cross-section and time-series factor models, the construction of optimal portfolios and the measurement of their performance — with modern statistical methodology including robust estimators that are not much influenced by outliers, influence function-based analyses of risk and performance estimators, and statistical process control-based monitoring of portfolio performance.

These techiques are applied to active equity and fixed income portfolios, as well as to the construction of specialized portfolios that are of great practical importance: miminimum downside risk portfolios, portfolios designed to defease liabililities and to meet spending objectives, and portfolios with options. Throughout, the authors emphasize the computational aspects of portfolio management and make available the companion open-source PCRA package and R code to reproduce many of the exhibits in the book as well as for *non-commercial* use by readers.

# Preface {#preface}

The [Preface](preface.qmd) provides an overview of the book's sixteen chapters and five appendices, describes its reproducibility theme as well as its supporting R packages (`PCRA`, `facmodCS`, `facmodTS`, `robustGarch`), motivates the use of robust estimators, introduces its special focus topics in Chapters 10–16, and includes disclaimers and conditions for the *non-commercial* use of CRSP, SPGMI, ICE, Tradeweb, S&P and CBOE datasets.

# Vignettes {#vignettes}

The book is accompanied by three vignettes that provide hands-on documentation for the `PCRA` R package and its data. PDFs are available for download on each vignette page.

```{=html}
<div class="appendix-grid">

  <div class="appendix-card">
```

# Appendices {#appendices}

This site hosts the five technical appendices to RPCRA. Each appendix provides self-contained background material that underpins the methods and results developed in the main text. Full PDF downloads are available on each appendix page.

- [Appendix A — Mathematical Tools for RPCRA](appendix-a.html)
- [Appendix B — Probability and Statistics for RPCRA](appendix-b.html)
- [Appendix C — Utility Theory](appendix-c.html)
- [Appendix D — Portfolio Theory](appendix-d.html)
- [Appendix E — Machine Learning](appendix-e.html)
